thread:
sophia: Heads-up: onboarding notes found a big SDK vs REST mismatch for embeddings batch flows. The Python SDK doesn't seem to support the `batch_id`/`metadata` fields we added to the REST bulk endpoint. QA hits silent degrades in throughput because server falls back to single embeddings.

tony: Can you paste the repro?

sophia: Sure. REST works:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"batch_id":"onboard-2026-03","inputs":["a","b"],"metadata":{"source":"sampleapp"}}'
```
This returns a 200 with batched response and metrics.

sophia: But Python SDK call:
```py
# python sdk
client.embeddings.batch(inputs=["a","b"], batch_id="onboard-2026-03", metadata={"source":"sampleapp"})
```
returns success but server logs show it routed to the single-embedding path. Outbound request captured from dev proxy: `{"inputs":["a","b"]}` — batch_id/metadata stripped.

ev an: That's odd. Our codegen recently flattened nested optional kwargs for embeddings to reduce signature complexity. Looks like the generator removed passthrough support for arbitrary kwargs on the batch method.

meera: Two customer-impact items: (1) SDK can't call the bulk endpoint at all so users get higher per-token cost and lower throughput; (2) drift in param names/shape vs REST means feature flags and downstream analytics don't see `batch_id`/metadata.

tony: Also noticed behavior diff on 409/422: when REST returns 422 for bad input, HTTP clients treat it as terminal; SDK runtime currently retries on 4xx for the embeddings batch call (we have an aggressive default for long-running ops), which results in duplicate processing and delayed failures. We should not retry 4xx by default.

sophia: Root cause (prelim): generator change removed a `_raw_body` passthrough and also the batch method in Python was mapped to the simple embeddings.create endpoint instead of embeddings.bulk. So missing endpoint + param mapping regression.

evan: Proposed fixes:
- generator: restore passthrough of extra JSON body fields for embeddings.batch and ensure Python method maps to /v1/embeddings/bulk when inputs > 1 or when batch_id provided.
- runtime: update retry classifier to treat 4xx as permanent (except 429). Add config hook to mark endpoint-specific transient codes.
- add unit/integration tests: assert outgoing JSON contains batch_id and metadata, and an integration test hitting the bulk path to verify metrics.

meera: Short-term mitigation: sampleapp will call REST bulk endpoint directly using requests.post to ensure throughput for onboarding. Also added a canary check to detect when SDK routes to single-embed path and to fallback to REST.

tony: Filed tracker: https://redwood.internal/p/SDK-PARITY-embeddings-204 to track missing endpoint + param drift + retry parity.

sophia: @evan can you own the generator patch? @tony you ok to take the runtime retry change + tests? I'll do the sampleapp fallback and create the integration test harness.

evan: Yep, will start on generator patch today. I'll add a migration note so we don't drop passthroughs in other namespaces.

tony: I'll update retry classifier and add a test that asserts 422 is not retried. Also add logging to show when SDK downgraded to single-embed path for easier detection.

ci-bot: CI: PR #5120 opened by evan  unit tests queued.

sophia: Thanks everyone. Please drop any other SDK vs REST parity surprises in this thread so we can triage together. :thumbsup:
